name: Rayne Young
caption: Billed the Enigma, the fed's website man and General Manager, who took the World title at All Hallows Annihilation on 19 November 2007, lost it to Annie Alvarez at Purgatory, and lost the first Whitecloud Memorial Tournament final to Dazz.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 7 January 2008) gives him the World title since All Hallows Annihilation (19/11/07), over Alcohol Paul, and the TV title; its staff page lists him as General Manager, website man, graphics crew and results writer; Dazz's Dedication and All Hallows Annihilation roleplays place him in the 21 April 2008 tournament final and in the World title match of 19 October 2009.

identity.note: The Enigma is also the whole name of a GIWF Television champion of 1999 to 2001 and of a 1991 WeWF wrestler; the nickname is all they share. Dark Rayne, a Hall of Fame inductee of the predecessor federation, shares only the forename. One MCW roleplay says Rayne Young briefly tried working for that predecessor, under no ring name it gives, so that question stays open.

name: Jacob Laymon
caption: The owner and CEO who signed the fed's first surviving news post, judged its roleplays and ran its storylines, and who is also named in a Dazz roleplay among the fed's past World champions.

tenures.source: Its news post of 22 November 2007 is signed as the owner; its staff page lists him as Owner/CEO (judges, storylines, everyday running); Dazz's Dedication roleplay lists him among the MCW World champions, and his Jay Williams roleplay says he was hired by Dazz and the earlier owner, Anthony Wallace, and later became the owner himself.

name: Annie Alvarez
caption: Took the World title from Rayne Young at Purgatory on 25 February 2008 after cashing in a title opportunity, and was billed holding the World, Brutality and Women's titles at once on the 7 April 2008 Mayhem card.

tenures.source: Its champions pages: Brutality champion since Mayhem (28/01/08) over Priest and Jonas Griffin, then World champion since Purgatory (25/02/08) over Rayne Young; the Mayhem cards of 26 February and 7 April 2008 bill her as World champion and as Women's champion with three straps.

name: Alcohol Paul
caption: A World champion whose title Rayne Young took at All Hallows Annihilation, billed against Brother James on 3 December 2007 and in a three-way on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 7 January 2008) names him as the man Rayne Young defeated at All Hallows Annihilation (19/11/07); the Mayhem cards of 3 December 2007 and 26 February 2008 bill him; a Dazz roleplay later lists him among the fed's past World champions.

name: Joshua Haze
caption: Billed with Whitecloud against Rayne Young and Kaplan James on 3 December 2007 after what the card called a stellar performance at All Hallows Annihilation, and named in the front page's Top 5 of that winter.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007 and its front page of 7 January 2008 (Rp'er of the Week and Top 5).

name: Jonas Griffin
caption: Billed for a three-way against Priest on 3 December 2007 and again on 26 February 2008, a wrestler the card said had looked bound for the World title and had come up short.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem cards of 3 December 2007 and 26 February 2008, its front page Top 5 lists, and its champions page: Annie Alvarez took the Brutality title from Priest and Jonas Griffin on 28 January 2008.

name: Brother James
caption: Billed against Alcohol Paul on 3 December 2007, a wrestler the card called eerily reminiscent of Paul in his earlier years, and ranked third in the front page's Top 5 of 31 January 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007 and its front page of 31 January 2008.

name: John Pariah
caption: Named Superstar of the Week on the front page of 31 January 2008 and billed in a three-way with Greg Venom and Luke Tanner on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its front page of 31 January 2008 and its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008.

identity.note: Name collision only: no shared operator, chronology or storyline links this record to the same-named record at another wing.

name: Doctor Ian
caption: Half of the tag team BROS, which took the Tag Team titles at Purgatory in February 2008, and the wrestler to whom Dazz handed the Whitecloud Memorial Tournament winner's World title shot in April 2008.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 8 May 2008) names BROS (Doctor Ian & Greg Venom) as Tag Team champions since Purgatory (25/02/08); its card of 26 February 2008 bills him in a three-way; Dazz's All Hallows Annihilation roleplay says the tournament winner's shot went to Doctor Ian, and his Livewire roleplay says Ian went on to hold the World title.
Described on 27 July 2009 as relatively new to SCCW; lost to Modo WHOA! that night; beat Alexander Steele on 10 August; named with Greg Venom as BROS.

name: Greg Venom
caption: Half of the tag team BROS, billed in a three-way on 26 February 2008 and in a ladder match for a Brutality title shot against Midas on 7 April 2008.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 8 May 2008) and its Mayhem cards of 26 February and 7 April 2008.
Lost to Patrick McCarthy on 27 July 2009 but earned a Brawl place; ranked eighth for the All Barrie title on 28 July; beat Justin Brooks and Blade on 10 August; named with Dr. Ian as BROS.

name: Kaplan James
caption: Held the Tag Team titles with Shitface McKee from 3 November 2007 until Purgatory, and teamed with Rayne Young on the 3 December 2007 card.

tenures.source: Its champions pages: Tag Team champion since 03/11/2007 with Shitface Mckee, defeated by BROS at Purgatory; its Mayhem cards of 3 December 2007 and 26 February 2008.

name: Shitface McKee
caption: Held the Tag Team titles with Kaplan James from 3 November 2007; the card of 3 December 2007 says he did well in the Battle Royal and set him against Luke Tanner.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 7 January 2008), billed as Shitface Mckee, and its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007.

name: Luke Tanner
caption: Billed against Shitface McKee on 3 December 2007 and in a three-way on 26 February 2008; one of the four teams beaten by BROS for the Tag Team titles at Purgatory.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem cards of 3 December 2007 and 26 February 2008 and its champions page (captured 8 May 2008).

name: Jared Baker
caption: Billed in a three-way with Priest and Jonas Griffin on 3 December 2007, a wrestler the card said had lasted an eternity in the Battle Royal.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007.

name: Whitecloud
caption: A Blackfoot Warrior gimmick wrestler billed with Joshua Haze on 3 December 2007 who had lost the Brutality title to Priest at All Hallows Annihilation; the fed named its Whitecloud Memorial Tournament, its Dedication pay-per-view and a trophy for him in 2008, and its roleplays speak of him as gone.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 7 January 2008) names him as the Brutality champion Priest defeated at All Hallows Annihilation; its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007 bills him; its card of 26 February 2008 announces the tournament named for him; Dazz's Dedication and All Hallows Annihilation roleplays dramatise it.

notes: Dazz's Dedication roleplay has him sign with the predecessor federation in June 2005, and that federation's own Hall of Fame page for Jake Fury has Fury beat him in a Chaos title tournament in July 2005.

name: Eric Sailes
caption: Whitecloud's son in the fed's roleplays, billed The Iceman and later, under one of his birth names, Golden Eagle, who calls Dazz Uncle, is a tag partner of Segador, and is shown being attacked on screen by Malakai Laymon before Nightmare Before Christmas.

tenures.source: Dazz's Dedication roleplay (Eric phones him in early January 2008 and is billed The Iceman), his All Hallows Annihilation roleplay (Whitecloud's son) and his Nightmare Before Christmas roleplay, which says the son of Whitecloud dropped the Iceman persona for Golden Eagle, calls Dazz Uncle and was attacked by Malakai Laymon; its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008 bills a Sailes against Valmont and Demon; the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial's Golden Eagle is Segador's partner.
the fed's own show pages (promotions/championship-wrestling-council-2008/)

identity.note: The Iceman is also the billing of an earlier BEW wrestler, of an unrelated Las Vegas magician-act wrestler in the predecessor federation's last broadcast, and of other wrestlers of other feds and decades; the nickname is all they share.

name: Kirsta Lewis
caption: Faced Faith in a dark match on 3 December 2007 and drew Dazz and Seth Cage in a three-way on 26 February 2008; a 2010 Dazz roleplay says she won a title-shot briefcase at the 2009 Dedication and then left the company.

tenures.source: Its champions page (a Tag Team challenger beaten on 03/11/2007) and its Mayhem cards of 3 December 2007 and 26 February 2008; Dazz's Livewire roleplays for the briefcase.

identity.note: Pending a verdict: the same uncommon full name in the same years. SCCW's "Hell Cat" Kirsta, also billed Kirsta Lewis, works Championship Wrestling Council's cards of January to April 2008 alongside an Eric "The Iceman" Sailes, as this Kirsta Lewis works MCW's cards beside a Sailes; Extreme Carnage ranks a Kirsta Lewis in May 2009. MCW's pages give her no moniker, so the records stay apart.

name: Matt Ward
caption: Billed in a dark-match three-way with Elrich and Jeff Young on 3 December 2007.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007.

identity.note: Name collision only: no shared operator, chronology or storyline links this record to the same-named record at another wing.

name: Elrich
caption: Billed in a dark-match three-way with Matt Ward and Jeff Young on 3 December 2007, one of two men the card said were returning.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007.

name: Jeff Young
caption: Billed in a dark-match three-way with Matt Ward and Elrich on 3 December 2007.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 3 December 2007.

name: Angelica Jones
caption: A multiple World champion by the fed's own later roleplays who faced Annie Alvarez for the Women's title on 7 April 2008, held the Motor City title until it was stripped when she took the World title from Dazz on 2 November 2009, and ran the Livewire brand.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem cards of 26 February and 7 April 2008; Dazz's Motor City contender, Title vs Title and Nightmare Before Christmas roleplays (Motor City champion, then World champion in 2009, with the Livewire brand run by her), and his Livewire roleplays.

name: Midas
caption: Billed in a three-way on 26 February 2008 and in a ladder match for a Brutality title shot against Greg Venom on 7 April 2008, and named in the front page's Top 5 of 2 June 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem cards of 26 February and 7 April 2008 and its front page of 2 June 2008.

name: Enzo Kanegawa
caption: Billed in a three-way on 26 February 2008 and, as Enzo, in a contract-on-a-steel-cage-roof match against Lance Conrad on 7 April 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem cards of 26 February and 7 April 2008; the second card bills only 'Enzo', taken here as the same man on the same roster six weeks later.

identity.note: Pending a verdict: the same unusual full name, and NAPW's 2008 roster cards bill Noir as born Enzo Kanegawa in the same 2007 to 2008 window as this record's February and April 2008 cards. MCW's cards give only the name, with no moniker, style or hometown to set beside Noir's, so the two records stay apart.

name: Chris Jacobs
caption: Billed against Alcohol Paul and Kaplan James on 26 February 2008 and named among the four teams beaten by BROS at Purgatory.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008 and its champions page (captured 8 May 2008).

name: Seth Cage
caption: Billed with Dazz and Kirsta Lewis on 26 February 2008, and beaten with Kaplan James, Luke Tanner and Chris Jacobs by BROS at Purgatory.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008, its champions page (captured 8 May 2008) and Dazz's All Hallows Annihilation roleplay (a tournament opponent).

name: Valmont
caption: Billed in a three-way with Demon and Sailes on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008.

name: Demon
caption: Billed in a three-way with Valmont and Sailes on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008.

identity.note: Name only. Championship Wrestling Council's The Demon (also billed Demon) works its cards of January to March 2008, the months this Demon is billed here beside a Sailes, but nothing beyond the bare name and the shared host ties them; the other Demons are of other feds and years.

name: D3
caption: Billed with Faith and Destiny Vixen on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008.

name: Destiny Vixen
caption: Billed with Faith and D3 on 26 February 2008.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 26 February 2008.

name: Ash Bombay
caption: Billed against Rayne Young, with Dazz as special guest referee, on 7 April 2008; Dazz's roleplays have him pulled from the tournament final for damaging property and sent against Jacob Laymon.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 7 April 2008 and front page of 2 June 2008; Dazz's All Hallows Annihilation roleplay.

identity.note: Pending a verdict: the same distinctive ring name, here on cards and roleplays of April to June 2008 and on two GCW cards in March 2009. MCW's pages give no moniker, style, hometown or entrance to set beside the GCW record's, so the two records stay apart.

name: Lance Conrad
caption: Billed against Enzo in a contract-on-a-steel-cage-roof match on 7 April 2008, with only the winner to stay in MCW.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 7 April 2008.

name: Meagan Collins
caption: Billed against the debuting Dante in a dark match on 7 April 2008, described as a long-time associate of Angelica Jones.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 7 April 2008.

name: Dante
caption: Billed on 7 April 2008 as the dark assassin kicking off his MCW career against Meagan Collins.

tenures.source: Its Mayhem card of 7 April 2008.

identity.note: Name collision only: no shared operator, chronology or storyline links this record to the same-named record at another wing.

name: Eric Moreland
caption: Named in the fed's champions page as the man whose TV title Rayne Young took.

tenures.source: Its champions page (captured 7 January 2008): the TV champion Rayne Young, defeated Eric Moreland.

name: Steven Brody
caption: The fed's face commentator on its staff page.

tenures.source: Its staff page (captured 8 May 2008).

name: Mike Sweeny
caption: The fed's heel commentator on its staff page.

tenures.source: Its staff page (captured 8 May 2008).

name: Segador
caption: A masked, high-flying wrestler, the first Millenium champion on Livewire and a former member of an undefeated team with Barney Green, who won a World title shot briefcase at All Hallows Annihilation and lost a cash-in by disqualification at Nightmare Before Christmas.

tenures.source: Dazz's Livewire six-person roleplay (first and current Millenium champion, the briefcase, the Green team) and his Nightmare Before Christmas roleplay; the Vitriol and Ambrosia chapters.

name: Vitriol
caption: A silent steel-masked wrestler who stalks MCW with his manager Michelle Richards, then with Ambrosia, loses a Buried Alive match to Priest at All Hallows Annihilation and takes the Tag Team titles with Ambrosia.

tenures.source: Chapters 1 to 5 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial; Dazz's Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire roleplays.

name: Ambrosia
caption: The daughter of Zolomon, who attacks Michelle Richards at All Hallows Annihilation with a steel chair, allies with Vitriol and takes the Tag Team titles with him, and who makes her own programme, Hollyweird.

tenures.source: Chapters 1 to 5 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial; Dazz's Livewire roleplays.

name: Zolomon
caption: Billed The Absolution, born Saul Manning, a veteran wrestler and the father of Ambrosia who leads the group Divinity with her and Vitriol.

tenures.source: Chapters 2 to 5 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial; Dazz's Livewire six-person roleplay names Divinity as Saul, Ambrosia and Vitriol.

name: Michelle Richards
caption: Vitriol's first manager, who spoke for him and was cast aside when Ambrosia took him over.

tenures.source: Chapters 1 and 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

name: Jay Williams
caption: Billed the Professor of Pain, half of Southern Blood, who challenged for the World title at Nightmare Before Christmas and lost the first Livewire Global title match to Dazz on 21 January 2010.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for 9 August 2009, 14 December 2009, 21 January 2010 and 4 February 2010.

name: Lance Williams
caption: Jay Williams's brother and partner in Southern Blood, a Tag Team champion who by Dazz's January 2010 account beat Priest to become World Heavyweight champion.

tenures.source: Dazz's Livewire roleplays and the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial's Chapter 2 (Southern Blood hold the Tag Team titles).

identity.note: Name collision only: no shared operator, chronology or storyline links this record to the same-named record at another wing.

name: Eric Herrera
caption: A former Cruiserweight champion who led Southern Blood, in Dazz's account trying to guide Jay and Lance Williams.

tenures.source: Dazz's Nightmare Before Christmas roleplay.

name: Kayla Jones
caption: Angelica Jones's younger sister and Tag Team partner, who teamed with Dazz and Axl Evermore against Hostile Takeover at Deadly Conflicts.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts, Title vs Title and Livewire.

name: Axl Evermore
caption: Billed for the Motor City contender match of 7 September 2009 and Dazz's tag partner at Deadly Conflicts, a boastful former champion of other companies.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for 7 September 2009, 21 September 2009 and Deadly Conflicts.

name: Lilith Evans
caption: A member of Hostile Takeover, beaten with Nick Cagero and Denile Partis by The Enforcers at Deadly Conflicts and, in Chapter 5 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial, named as Vitriol's half sister.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts and Charged Chamber; Chapter 5 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

name: Denile Partis
caption: A Hostile Takeover member beaten at Deadly Conflicts and entered in the Charged Chamber's second cage.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts and Charged Chamber.

name: Nick Cagero
caption: A Hostile Takeover member beaten at Deadly Conflicts who, by Dazz's roleplays, beat Skye on her Nightmare Before Christmas return.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts, Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire.

name: Malakai Laymon
caption: Jacob Laymon's brother, who formed Hostile Takeover to unseat him and, by Dazz's account, attacked Eric Sailes on screen before Nightmare Before Christmas.

tenures.source: Dazz's roleplays for Deadly Conflicts, Charged Chamber and Nightmare Before Christmas.

name: Aerik Walker
caption: Billed The Silverwolf, a seven-foot veteran who lost the first Livewire Millenium title match to Segador and wrestled Rayne Young in late 2009.

tenures.source: Dazz's Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire roleplays; Chapters 1 and 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

name: Brittany Lohan
caption: A powerlifter-built member of the trio that attacked Livewire's top stars in its first weeks.

tenures.source: Dazz's Livewire six-person roleplay.

name: Aaron Dietrich
caption: A German-born member of the Livewire trio who billed himself the Prince of MCW.

tenures.source: Dazz's Livewire six-person roleplay.

name: Barney Green
caption: Segador's former undefeated tag partner, who beat Dazz in October 2009 and is named among the tag battle royale's field in Chapter 2.

tenures.source: Dazz's Nightmare Before Christmas and Livewire roleplays; Chapters 1 and 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

identity.note: Pending a verdict: the same name in the same month, October 2009, here and on three GCW cards, and both are big men (the serial's portly drinker, GCW's 320-pound brawler). MCW's pages give no moniker, finisher or hometown to set beside the GCW record's Green Dream and Las Vegas billing, so the records stay apart; the Barney Greens of BLWA (March and April 2008) and NLWF (February and March 2009) share the bare name only.

name: Lethal Weapon
caption: A past World champion by Dazz's account and half of a father-and-son team in the tag battle royale of Chapter 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

tenures.source: Dazz's Title vs Title roleplay and Chapter 2 of the Vitriol and Ambrosia serial.

identity.note: Name collision only: no shared operator, chronology or storyline links this record to the same-named record at another wing.
